name: TOB Bible Journey
description: One guided journey through multiple biblical places (e.g. 'Paul's Missionary Journeys'). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.bible_places (never raw REST for a normal user). A journey's ordered stops live in TOB Bible Journey Stop, linked back here.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published journeys are ever returned to the app.
